data.title: NetzMuster price increase from 1 April 2026
data.summary: NetzMuster GmbH announces that the monthly base price of your "Muster DSL 250" plan rises from €39.99 to €44.99 on 1 April 2026. The letter is dated 16 February 2026 and mentions a special right to cancel.
data.explanation: Your internet provider is raising your monthly price by €5.00. Because of this, you have a special right to cancel (Sonderkündigungsrecht) without notice period and without costs. The letter says you can use it within three months after receiving the notice, at the earliest when the change takes effect. You can decide whether to accept the new price or cancel or switch to another provider. The app shows until when you can cancel. If you do nothing, the new price applies from the effective date.
